items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Sunday vs Raiders due to rib injury. Practiced Friday.
items.why: Ribs; practiced but status impacts Herbert and LAC WRs heavily; 4pm ET start.
items.implication: Biggest Q on slate per Levitan; if out, Johnston/others rise, Herbert projections drop.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE: Quentin Johnston target/route surge; if IN: full volume.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Week 2 vs Bengals. Injury not believed serious but keeps him out at least this week after limited/no practice Thu/Fri.
items.why: Hamstring tweak in Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri; source says not serious long-term.
items.implication: HOU WR room depleted (already lost Higgins); Schultz/Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel elevate for targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers; Stroud volume spreads thin.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Missed majority of practices this week after aggravating in Week 1.
items.why: Hamstring; limited/no practice most of week; Ja'Kobi Lane also out (IR/return wrist).
items.implication: BAL WRs down to crumbs (Bateman primary); Andrews target share boost likely.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Bateman/Walker/Wester; TE Mark Andrews hierarchy rise.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee (post-meniscus trim). Returned to practice Friday but needs more time; pregame workout possible.
items.why: Knee surgery cleanup; first practice Friday with sleeve; HC Kubiak optimistic for next week if sits.
items.implication: Michael Mayer continues as primary TE; LV pass game without top option again.
items.opportunity: Mayer snaps/routes/targets spike; Jeanty utilization remains high.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN and ready for 2026 debut. Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR/return; question if 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go per reports; AJ Brown ankle IR/return leaves NE needing explosives; matchups favorable (PIT etc).
items.implication: Potential 10+ touch role expansion in debut; Stevenson handcuff/share risk.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes/touches increase for Henderson; NE WR crumbs otherwise.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate; affects so many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to WR crumbs.
items.why: Ribs Q status cascades to Herbert/LAC offense and opposing game script.
items.implication: Monitor closely; Herbert/LAC WRs volatile; if out major pivot.
items.opportunity: Herbert ceiling tied to McConkey health; Johnston etc if absent.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Week 2. Expected back squeezes Etienne/Miller committee further.
items.why: Return from absence; ETR Sunday list.
items.implication: NO RBBC tighter; Etienne passing work at risk; underdog script bad for rush.

items.text: AJ Brown OUT (or doubtful group) for Week 2; on IR/return with ankle per Levitan context. NE desperate for playmakers.
items.why: Ankle; listed in ETR OUT/DOUBTFUL; impacts NE offense.
items.implication: NE WRs crumbs; boosts Henderson opportunity and other pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Henderson touches; remaining NE skill upside.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury, but Burrow said he would play.
items.implication: Expected to play per ETR/Levitan notes; CIN offense full if so vs depleted HOU.
items.opportunity: Chase/Higgins/Brown full if Burrow IN; monitor for any limitation.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter for SF backfield.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black Q impacts share slightly.
items.implication: CMC elevated projections; monitor Black for any change.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/route share continues; Black handcuff if elevated.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps) through 3Q Week 1, 40% route targets (team lead), 24% tgt share. Indy gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. Could finish as RB1.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage (tgt share career-high range) + soft matchup.
items.implication: Start with confidence as high-end RB1; massive season range if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share; passing-game work elite.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% tgt share last 10 games. Hit 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Kubiak offense boost.
items.why: Elite util + passing usage; soft LAC defense; prior injury overreaction.
items.implication: RB8+ start; workhorse upside with Bowers doubtful.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share Week 1, every RB RZ touch, out-routed Gainwell by 8. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing + RZ dominance confirmed; good matchup.
items.implication: RB17+ with upside to much higher; start confidently.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO underdog bad rush script.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara IN; poor Week 1 early-down share; tough matchup/script.
items.implication: Fade/sit; low floor in three-headed backfield.
items.opportunity: Reduced carries/targets; Kamara takes receiving/3rd down.
